dynamic_line: I don't know if you've met Jay yet, but he and I split a garden out here.  We both work - well, worked - in technology, and we were convinced the world was ending so we both got property outside town.  We met when he moved in next door.  So this is our little homestead with a few upgrades.  We aren't really sweating property lines at this point.

responses.text: What's with all the weapons and armor?

dynamic_line: I make them myself!  I've always loved traditional armaments and am a proud member of the SCA!  Figured now that everything has gone to hell I can make it a full-time thing.  Lots of survivors in need of a big ol' hammer or some armored guards to keep the biters off.

responses.text: It must take some serious equipment to make all this.

dynamic_line: Well, what can I say, I had lots of disposable income.  Kept me busy and all that.  So yeah, I've got a pretty impressive shop in the back.

responses.text: Still this is a lot of equipment.  Wouldn't it have been easier to buy this stuff from a manufacturer?
